query:
UPDATE customers
        SET name      = COALESCE($2, name),
            tax_id    = COALESCE($3, tax_id),
            email     = COALESCE($4, email),
            phone     = COALESCE($5, phone),
            is_active = COALESCE($6, is_active),
            credit_limit = CASE WHEN $7::bool THEN $8 ELSE credit_limit END
        WHERE id = $1
